findings.description:
Reentrancy in AssetSale.sweepExcessETH() (contracts/AssetSale.sol#107-113):
	External calls:
	- (ok,None) = issuer.call{value: excess}() (contracts/AssetSale.sol#110)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- ExcessETHSwept(excess) (contracts/AssetSale.sol#112)
findings.disposition: Existing AssetSale event-order warning; no demonstrated double payout. Original accounting and tests retained; new offering uses nonReentrant.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in AssetSale.withdrawProceeds() (contracts/AssetSale.sol#94-101):
	External calls:
	- (ok,None) = issuer.call{value: amount}() (contracts/AssetSale.sol#98)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- ProceedsWithdrawn(amount) (contracts/AssetSale.sol#100)
findings.disposition: Existing AssetSale event-order warning; no demonstrated double payout. Original accounting and tests retained; new offering uses nonReentrant.

findings.description:
SubscriptionOffering.finalizeOffering() (contracts/SubscriptionOffering.sol#140-158) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- finalized || block.timestamp < subscriptionEnd (contracts/SubscriptionOffering.sol#141)
findings.disposition: Intended subscription start/end boundary, tested without randomness or second-level fairness claims.

findings.description:

findings.disposition: Intended subscription start/end boundary, tested without randomness or second-level fairness claims.
